result:
Done. I've set up a persistent sync daemon using systemd that will:

**Survive restarts:** Uses systemd timer which persists across reboots and automatically restarts on login
**Auto-start:** Enabled to start automatically on boot and then run every hour  
**Handle failures:** Automatically restarts on failure (up to 3 times per minute)

Three new files have been committed:
- **`sync-loop.sh`** — wrapper that runs sync in a loop with 1-hour intervals
- **`sync-daemon.{service,timer}`** — systemd unit files for the daemon
- **`install-sync-daemon.sh`** — setup script that installs and enables everything

To activate, run: `bash scripts/install-sync-daemon.sh`
